title: Poulet au dalang (Chicken with Dalang)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A hen cut in pieces, marinated 15–20 minutes, fried with onion, then simmered with dalang, a little water, ginger, garlic and salt until tender, adding water until the end.
longDesc: p. 66 of the October 2023 recipe book. A hen is cut in pieces. Onion is fried in oil and the chicken added; then dalang, a little water, ginger, crushed garlic and salt; it cooks until tender, adding water until the end. The tips: marinate 15–20 minutes, and let the first water evaporate before adding more. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: 1 hen, cut in pieces — weight not printed
Oil, onion, garlic, ginger, salt, dalang, chilli, water — quantities not printed
steps: Fry the onion in oil. Add the chicken.
Add the dalang, a little water, ginger, crushed garlic and salt.
Cook until tender, adding water until the end. Let the first water evaporate before adding more.
chefTips: The printed doneness cue is ‘until tender’.
Let the first water evaporate before adding more.
commonMistakes: Adding all the water at once.
Stopping before the chicken is tender.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Poulet au dalang’ (p. 66). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0.
